title: Mystic Fox Mage in Battle
description: A fox-eared mage with long white hair and a red hooded robe dynamically leaps through a dark forest, holding a glowing purple staff in one hand and a large crescent magical weapon in the other. Swirling blue and orange energy effects, runes, and floating red leaves surround him as he casts a bright blue orb of magic from his raised left hand.
prompt: A dynamic fox spirit mage with white flowing hair, fox ears and a red hooded robe with white fur trim, leaping mid-air through a dark misty forest. He holds a glowing purple magical staff in one hand and a large crescent golden weapon with runes in the other. He is casting a bright blue orb of swirling magical energy from his raised hand, surrounded by glowing runes, blue energy trails, and floating red leaves. Epic fantasy style, dramatic lighting, detailed digital painting.
